arch_opening: There is an update available — version 1.6.0. It's entirely on the Codex side: Three Man Team now ships as a Codex skill, so the methodology runs in Codex sessions too. If you only use Claude Code, nothing in your project changes — I'll just mark you up to date.

changes.title: Codex skill package (codex-skill/)
changes.what_changed: The full methodology is adapted as a Codex skill: SKILL.md with description-triggered invocation, playbooks and role templates as references, a project scaffolding script (setup-project.sh), a local version checker, and an optional @three-man-team Codex plugin.
changes.old_behavior: Three Man Team ran only under Claude Code.
changes.new_behavior: The same workflow runs in Codex: you are the Architect, and Builder/Reviewer spawn via Codex's spawn_agent.
changes.user_impact_plain: Claude Code projects need no changes. If you also use Codex, you can install the skill from the framework clone's codex-skill/ directory.
changes.how_to_assess: Ask whether the user works in Codex as well as Claude Code. If no: nothing to do — write version_notified and move on. If yes: point them at the clone's codex-skill/ directory and the README's Codex Integration section (cp -R codex-skill ~/.codex/skills/three-man-team, then scripts/setup-project.sh).
changes.user_decision: Do you also use Codex? If so, want me to walk through installing the Codex skill? If not, there's nothing to apply — you're current.
